args.subject: Re: Draft: Acme contract (for review)
args.body:
Hi all,

Confirmation of next steps for the vendor distribution list:

- I will compile the vendor distribution list from Procurement and Vendor Ops (name, company, role, and best contact email).
- I will send the compiled list to Legal for review/approval to ensure no restricted parties or confidentiality issues.
- Once Legal signs off and we have the final contract, I will distribute the contract to the approved vendor list and track who it was sent to.

Please send any additional vendor contacts you want included by EOD Wednesday, or let me know if you want a different deadline. If you’d prefer, I can wait to distribute until we receive final signature from Acme—confirm your preference.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
